response: Yes, locoregional opening of the rodent blood-brain barrier for paclitaxel using Nd:YAG laser-induced thermo therapy represents a new concept of adjuvant glioma therapy. This approach aims to enhance the delivery of paclitaxel, a chemotherapeutic agent, to brain tumors by temporarily disrupting the blood-brain barrier using laser-induced heat therapy, thereby improving treatment outcomes for glioma patients.
